name: polaris-browser-use
description: Reuses your signed-in Chrome for general web reading and interaction, with token-efficient output.

interface.shortDescription: Read and operate web pages in your signed-in Chrome, token-efficiently.
interface.longDescription:
The official Polaris general-purpose browser plugin. It reuses your everyday signed-in Chrome session and provides token-efficient page reading and DOM-snapshot interaction. It works strictly inside a window created by Polaris and never disturbs your other tabs. For known social platforms, use the polaris-social plugin.

Requires: Python ≥3.14, Chrome.
defaultPrompt: 打开 https://example.com 并阅读正文。
